description:
Request access to SpiderIQ API. This sends an approval email to the admin.
After calling this, use check_access_status to poll for approval.
Once approved, the token is automatically saved for subsequent API calls.

email.description: Admin email address (the person who will approve access)

recover_as.description: Recover an existing agent by its OPVS address (username). Only takes effect when NO PAT is stored — a held PAT always rotates the SAME account.

name: request_access
